_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: An expired exe.dev login reloads the page into the auth flow, keeping its place. The page's EventSource is a fake (the page already defines it): window.__testStream is the stream the app opened, and the test fails it as a dropped connection would. The server answers GET /api/upload/raw, the app's login probe, with a 307 redirect to /__exe.dev/login?redirect=%2Fnew, as exe.dev does once the login has expired. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new#keep-my-place; the element with data-testid "message-input" should be visible. 2. Fail the stream with one eval: (() => { const s = window.__testStream; if (!s || !s.onerror) throw new Error("global stream was not initialized"); s.readyState = 0; s.onerror(); return "failed"; })() which must return "failed". 3. The page must reload: performance.getEntriesByType("navigation")[0]?.type should become exactly "reload". 4. location.hash must be exactly "#keep-my-place".
